entities.name: Christian Lépine
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christian Lépine is a Canadian prelate of the Catholic Church who has been Archbishop of Montreal since March 2012, after eight months as an auxiliary bishop there. With the exception of two years working in the Roman Curia he has spent his entire career in Montreal.
